overview: Set in the proverbial boomtowns of West-Texas and a modern-day tale of fortune-seeking in the world of oil rigs, the series is an upstairs/downstairs story of roughnecks and wildcat billionaires that are fueling a boom so big it’s reshaping our climate, our economy and our geopolitics.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: In season two, as oil rises from the earth, so do secrets - and Tommy Norris's breaking point may be closer than he realizes. Facing mounting pressure from M-Tex Oil, Cami Miller, and the shadow of his kin, survival in West Texas isn't noble - it's brutal. And sooner or later something's got to break.

results.name: The Sticky
results.overview: Ruth Clarke, a tough, supremely competent middle-aged Canadian maple syrup farmer has had it with being hemmed in by the polite, bureaucratic conventions native to her country’s identity. With the help of Remy Bouchard, a pint-sized local blockhead and an aging Mike Byrne, a low-level mobster, Ruth changes her fate — and transforms the future of her community with the theft of millions of dollars’ worth of maple syrup.

results.name: Catching Killers
results.overview: The investigators behind infamous serial killer cases reveal the harrowing, chilling details of their extraordinary efforts in this true crime series.

results.name: Dig
results.overview: When FBI Agent Peter Connelly, recently stationed in Jerusalem, begins investigating the murder of a young American, he realizes that he’s uncovered an ancient international conspiracy that threatens to change the course of human history. Certain that the dangerous prophecy is nearing fruition, Peter must race against the clock to unravel its mystery. From a remote farm in Norway, to an enigmatic compound in New Mexico, to the serpentine tunnels of Jerusalem, he searches for the truth, the revelation of which will shake the world's beliefs to its very core.

results.name: Snapped
results.overview: The fascinating cases of every day, seemingly average moms, wives and girlfriends accused of murder. Did they really do it? And if so, why?

results.name: Three Women
results.overview: Three women from different walks of life take radical steps to explore their true desires, while struggling to emerge from a prison of expectations. A writer, grieving her own loss, persuades each of them to tell her their stories.

results.name: Final Draft
results.overview: Twenty-five athletes, most retired, compete to win 30M yen to launch their second career. Can they overcome tough physical and psychological challenges?

results.name: Paul American
results.overview: Global sports and entertainment superstars Jake and Logan Paul are pulling back the curtain for their latest venture: a family reality TV show.

results.name: What It Feels Like for a Girl
results.original_name: What It Feels Like for a Girl
results.overview: To find yourself, sometimes you need to lose yourself. It's Y2K, and Byron's flirting with discovery and destruction, love and anarchy. Inspired by Paris Lees's raw, riotous memoir.

results.name: Marvel Lucha Libre Edition: El origen de la máscara
results.original_name: Marvel Lucha Libre Edition: El origen de la máscara
results.overview: The new series was revealed during the pre-shot of AAA’s event, TripleMania XXX: CDMX, where the first trailer was shown. This new series features wrestling matches, but with wrestlers in outfits that are inspired by Marvel Super Heroes.

results.name: Love You to Death
results.overview: Raúl's world is unraveling. Marta's unexpectedly pregnant. After a funeral meet-cute brings them together, they stumble through the chaos of life and love.

results.name: George Lopez: Muy Católico
results.overview: Live from the Dolby Theatre, George Lopez brings his reflections on aging, Latino family dynamics, and cultural quirks in his final stand-up special. He hilariously embraces the challenges of getting older and touches on generational clashes and Latino superstitions. Bold and personal, Lopez delivers his comedic voice to stories that capture both the humor and heart of his journey one last time.

results.name: Best Shape of My Life
results.overview: Will Smith teams up with guests and undergoes a fitness challenge.

results.name: Little Miss Innocent: Passion. Poison. Prison.
results.original_name: Little Miss Innocent: Passion. Poison. Prison.
results.overview: Speaking for the first time since her conviction for the killing of her ex-boyfriend's mother, Kaitlyn Conley goes on camera to assert her innocence.
A prequel to Yellowstone featuring a new generation of the Dutton family ranchers in the 1940s.

results.name: Wayward
results.overview: A small-town cop suspects that the local school for troubled teens — and its dangerously charismatic founder — may not be all it seems.

results.name: City on Fire
results.overview: A college student is shot in Central Park on July 4, 2003. The investigation connects a series of mysterious citywide fires, the downtown music scene, and a wealthy uptown real estate family fraying under the strain of the many secrets they keep.

results.name: Se llamaba Pedro Infante
results.overview: A promise to his mother led him to become the best musical and movie star of the Golden Age of Mexican cinema; his songs and characters went around the world, and when he seemed to have everything, death tragically took him away.

results.name: You Would Do It Too
results.overview: A bus is hijacked by three robbers—who end up dead before they can get away. Every passenger's story is the same: A hooded man saved the day. As the case unfolds, the line between hero and criminal begins to blur.

results.name: Public Disorder
results.overview: Following the fateful aftermath of a demonstration, tensions rise within a riot squad that struggles to separate work from personal life.
